source: Science Advances published main PDF, page 6, Fig.4B
method: render official PDF crop at 6 pixels/point; isolate blue RGB pixels; columnwise contiguous-cluster continuity extraction
path_coordinate: 0=M,1=Gamma,2=X,3=M; equal-width plotted segments; not physical arclength
uncertainty_status: conservative visual estimates, not statistical confidence intervals
limitations: Rasterized source plot, not vector numerical eigenvalues
Blue band peak does not exactly coincide with author red Gamma guide (~0.05 THz difference)
136 THz modulation is rounded and includes DC shift, not exact static Gamma data
Rendering/digitization yields highly correlated pixel samples
No linewidth or Q can be quantitatively inferred from color opacity
Nearby pale bands and vertical artifact-like dots excluded; main flat branch only
Fine oscillations near the X horizontal red guide arise from occlusion/anti-aliasing in the blue-pixel mask, not resolved band oscillations; use coarse shape and error envelope.
